The agent never applies for them, and no document tells the agent to offer a card unprompted.

info.about: The approximate dollar amount of the single large purchase the customer plans to put on the new card.

steps.do: Greet the customer politely. Identity verification is not needed, because no customer records are looked up or changed and the customer submits the application themselves. Verify only if the lookup_user branch below is triggered.
steps.quote: You should ONLY verify a user's identity if you need to access or modify their customer information in internal databases on their behalf.

steps.do: Confirm the customer wants a new business credit card that gives the most money back on one large purchase. Ask for purchase_amount, purchase_type, business_type and existing_rho_bank_credit_cards if they have not said them. Identity verification is not needed for a recommendation because no records are looked up. Verify (2 of DOB, email, phone, address, then log_verification) only if you must open the customer's records.
steps.quote: Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate.

steps.do: Ask for whichever of these the customer has not given: the purchase amount, the billing merchant, what is being bought (its category) and the type of business. Ask only for missing facts.
steps.quote: Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer already holds any Rho-Bank credit cards. Promos and fee waivers are for new customers only.
steps.if: the customer has not already said whether they hold Rho-Bank credit cards
steps.quote: Offer is for new customers only and applies to new accounts opened within the promotion window.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record by the name they gave. If they gave an email, use get_user_information_by_email. If they gave a user id, use get_user_information_by_id.
steps.if: the customer says they already hold Rho-Bank credit cards and is unsure which, so their accounts must be read to judge new-customer promo eligibility
steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Check that 2 of the values the customer gave (date of birth, email, phone, address) match the record from lookup_user. Reveal nothing from the record until they match. If they never match, do not read any accounts. Give the recommendation with new-customer promos marked as subject to eligibility.
steps.quote: Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.

steps.do: Get the current date. Use it for every promo-window check and for the verification log. Never assume the date.
steps.quote: This offer is available from 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit card accounts. If the customer already holds a card type, that card's new-customer promo or fee waiver does not apply.
steps.quote: Open your account within the promotional window and meet new customer eligibility criteria

steps.do: Decide which reward category the purchase falls in for each card. Remember that each card has its own bonus categories. Categories: Travel, Software (subscriptions, licenses, cloud), Media (advertising, streaming), Green/Sustainable, Operations, Transportation (logistics, shipping, rideshare), or Other. A vehicle purchase is not listed as travel, software, media, operations or sustainable, so it earns each card's default rate unless a document says otherwise.
steps.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

steps.do: Check the billing merchant (gather_purchase) against each card's own exclusion list, and apply an exclusion only to the card whose document lists it. Business Silver: Apple, Microsoft and Dell (hardware), Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus and Nintendo Switch Online (gaming), and Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, Skillshare and Pluralsight (online learning) earn only 1.0%, not the 10.0% software rate. Concur, SAP Concur, Expensify and Navan earn only 1.0%, not the 10.0% travel rate. These exclusions still apply during the 2x promo. Business Bronze: WeWork, Regus and Industrious (coworking) and Gusto, ADP, Paychex and Rippling (payroll) earn 0%. Slack, Zoom, HubSpot and Salesforce earn 1.0% for the first 12 months of a subscription, then 0%. If the merchant is on no list, no exclusion applies.
steps.quote: The following specific merchants do NOT earn the 10.0% bonus rate and instead earn the standard 1.0% rate:

steps.do: Business Bronze Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0%. Add a $500 statement credit if today (get_time) is within 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 and net purchases reach $10,000 within 2 months. Annual fee is $0.00.
steps.quote: Make net new purchases totaling $10,000 within the first 2 months of account opening.

steps.do: Business Silver Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (non travel/software), doubled only if the account opens within 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14. Annual fee is $122.50, or 0 in the first year if the account opens within 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15.
steps.quote: New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening their account.

steps.do: Business Silver Rewards Card: software and travel earn 10.0%, other purchases 1.0%. Merchants on the exclusion list, including Apple, Microsoft and Dell, earn only 1.0%. The 2x promo counts only for accounts opened 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14.
steps.quote: The following specific merchants do NOT earn the 10.0% bonus rate and instead earn the standard 1.0% rate:

steps.do: Business Gold Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (a vehicle is not listed as operations spend), or 2.5% if the purchase is operations spend. Annual fee is $200.00.
steps.quote: Purchases that do not qualify as operations spend earn cash back at 1.0%.

steps.do: Business Platinum Rewards Card: purchase × 1.5% (non travel/software/media). Annual fee is $450.00, or 0 in the first year if the account opens within 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28.
steps.quote: Purchases outside those categories earn 1.5%.

steps.do: Business Platinum Rewards Card: travel, software and media earn 4.0%, everything else 1.5%. A streaming or software subscription counts as software or media. No merchant exclusion list applies. The credit limit can reach $400,000.
steps.quote: Travel, software, and media advertising purchases earn 4.0%.

steps.do: Green Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (not a sustainable merchant), or 3.0% at a qualifying sustainable merchant. Annual fee is $100.00.
steps.quote: Purchases at qualifying sustainable merchants earn 3.0%, while all other eligible purchases earn 1.0%.

steps.do: Silver Zoom Card: purchase × 1.0%, or 3.0% for transportation/logistics. Multiply by 3 only if today is still within the triple promo claim window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Annual fee is $74.50. Consider this card only if the customer's business is a transportation/logistics operator.
steps.quote: All other eligible purchases earn 3 × 1.0% during the promo period

steps.do: Rate the other business cards. Gold: 2.5% on operations, 1.0% otherwise, $200 fee. Bronze: 1.0% plus a $500 credit for $10,000 spent in 2 months (offer runs 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31), but its credit line tops out at $50,000. Green: 3.0% only at sustainable merchants, credit line up to $75,000. Silver Zoom: logistics card, 3x promo only if claimed by 2025-12-31.
steps.quote: Spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit.

steps.do: Drop any card whose documented maximum credit line is below the purchase amount: the purchase could not fit on it. Maximum lines: Business Bronze $50,000; Green Rewards $75,000; Business Silver $112,500; Silver Zoom $175,000; Business Gold $225,000; Business Platinum $400,000. Tell the customer the actual limit is set by underwriting.
steps.quote: Keep spending within your assigned credit limit and monitor available credit before initiating large transactions.

steps.do:
For each card left after check_credit_line:
1. Cash back = purchase_amount × rate, rounded down to whole points (1 point = $0.01). Use the excluded rate wherever check_merchant_exclusions found the merchant on that card's list.
2. Add any promo the customer qualifies for on today's date.
3. Pick exactly one card, the one with the highest total.
4. State the breakdown: cash back + promo = total. Mention the annual fee separately.
For a software or streaming purchase from an Apple-type merchant, this is the Business Platinum Rewards Card at 4.0%. For a purchase in no bonus category, while its window is open, Business Bronze (1.0% plus the $500 credit) beats Business Platinum (1.5%) when the purchase is under $100,000 and at or below Bronze's $50,000 line.
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Present the single card from compute_and_recommend, even if the customer asks about several. State its cash back, its promo amount, the total and the annual fee. Give the promo conditions, for example that the $10,000 in net spend must post within 2 months and that returns reduce it. Say that approval and the credit line come from underwriting. Give the card's minimum personal credit score: Bronze 660, Green 690, Silver 700, Gold 735, Platinum 765, Silver Zoom 680.
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Explain the Business Platinum annual fee: $0 for the first year if the account is opened 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28, otherwise $450.00.
steps.if: the recommended card is the Business Platinum Rewards Card
steps.quote: After the first year, the standard annual fee applies: $450.00

steps.do: Tell the customer the triple cash back is not automatic: they must claim it in the account portal under promotional offers, within the claim window.
steps.if: the recommended card is the Silver Zoom Card and its triple promo was counted
steps.quote: Select the triple cash back offer and confirm your acceptance within the claim window

steps.do: Confirm that the customer understands the total return. Tell them any condition, such as meeting the promo spend within the window or claiming a promo in the portal.
steps.if: customer asks to confirm the expected return
steps.quote: Plan larger purchases early in the period so they post within 2 months.

steps.do: Before the customer applies, ask for any of these they have not given: full name, annual income, and whether they have a Rho-Bank+ subscription. Restate the recommended card's exact name.
steps.if: the customer wants to apply and has not given all three application details
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your legal name, address, and Social Security number.

steps.do: The customer applies for the recommended card with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. The agent does not apply for them.

args.card_type: the recommended card's exact name, e.g. 'Business Bronze Rewards Card' or 'Business Platinum Rewards Card'

steps.quote: Review and submit your application.

steps.do: Confirm the application result. If approved, remind the customer of the promo conditions. If it was declined or returned an error, explain the stated reason. Do not apply for another card unless the customer asks.
steps.quote: Only net purchases count; returns or credits reduce your qualifying total.

steps.do: Tell the customer that the bonus rate counted in the recommendation depends on how the merchant codes the charge. For a large software purchase, they should pay the software provider directly and confirm the merchant category coding beforehand, so the enhanced rate applies.
steps.if: the application was submitted and the recommendation counted a bonus-category rate (e.g. Business Platinum's 4.0% on software or media)
steps.quote: Confirm merchant category coding for large renewals to ensure the enhanced rate of 4.0%.

steps.do: If the application fails in a way no document covers, or the customer insists on a human, explain what you can and cannot do. Ask whether they want a transfer, and call transfer_to_human_agents only if they say yes.

args.summary: the recommendation given and what failed
args.reason: the error or the customer's request

steps.if: the issue cannot be resolved with the documents and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool.

jobs.done_when:
All of the following are true:
- The agent has recommended exactly one business card, and the purchase fits within that card's documented credit line.
- The billing merchant has been checked against each card's exclusion list.
- The agent gave a dollar breakdown of the return (cash back + any promo = total), the promo conditions, and the annual fee stated separately.
- Promo windows were checked against get_current_time.
- If records were read, the customer was verified and the verification was logged.
- The customer has applied for that card with apply_for_credit_card and the result was explained, or the customer declined.

open_questions: Streaming services are listed under Media in doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005 but under Entertainment in doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019. An enterprise streaming license could also count as Software. The category decides whether Business Platinum pays 4.0% or 1.5%.
Business Platinum's 4.0% covers 'media advertising'. It is unclear whether a Media charge that is not advertising (e.g. a streaming subscription) earns 4.0% unless it counts as a software license.
It is unclear whether a business outside transportation and logistics can be approved for the Silver Zoom Card.
Business Silver's first-year fee waiver: docs _001 and _009 give it to all new customers, while _011 limits it to 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15.
The documents do not say whether to subtract the first-year annual fee when ranking cards by 'money back'. The workflow ranks by cash back plus promo credits and states the fee separately.
No document says how annual_income or rho_bank_subscription affect business card eligibility in apply_for_credit_card.

steps.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

steps.do: Get today's date. You need it to check which promotion and fee-waiver windows are open.
steps.quote: The 6-month window begins on your account opening date, not the promotional start date

steps.do: Put the purchase into exactly one category from the valid rewards-category list (Travel, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations, Transportation, Groceries, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Shopping, Other), based on the merchant and item the customer described. The list puts streaming services under Media and licenses/subscriptions under Software.
steps.quote: Media (advertising spend, streaming services)

steps.do: For each business card, check that card's own exclusion list against the billing merchant. Business Silver: Apple, Microsoft, Dell, Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, Nintendo Switch Online, Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, Skillshare and Pluralsight earn only 1.0% instead of 10.0%. Concur, SAP Concur, Expensify and Navan also earn only 1.0% on travel. Business Bronze: WeWork, Regus, Industrious, Gusto, ADP, Paychex and Rippling earn 0%. Slack, Zoom, HubSpot and Salesforce earn 0% after the first 12 months. Apply an exclusion only to the card whose document lists it.
steps.quote: The following specific merchants do NOT earn the 10.0% bonus rate and instead earn the standard 1.0% rate:

steps.do: Drop any card whose maximum credit limit is below the purchase amount, because the charge cannot fit on it. Maximums: Business Bronze $50,000; Business Silver $112,500; Business Gold $225,000; Business Platinum $400,000; Green Rewards $75,000; Silver Zoom $175,000.
steps.quote: Your initial credit line will be at least $10,000 and may be as high as $50,000 based on underwriting.

steps.do: Using today's date, list the new-customer promotions open now. Business Bronze: $500 statement credit for $10,000 net spend in the first 2 months, window 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31. Business Silver: 2x cash back for 6 months, account must open 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14, and merchant exclusions still apply. Silver Zoom: 3x standard rates for 9 months, must be claimed 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Business Platinum: first-year fee 0, window 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28. Business Silver: first-year fee 0, window 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15. Count a promotion only if today is inside its window and the customer is new to that card.
steps.quote: You must open your account during the promotional period to qualify

steps.do: For each remaining business card, find the rate for the purchase's category after exclusions. Rates: Bronze 1.0%. Silver 10.0% travel/software, 1.0% other. Gold 2.5% operations, 1.0% other. Platinum 4.0% travel/software/media, 1.5% other. Green 3.0% sustainable, 1.0% other. Silver Zoom 3.0% transportation/logistics, 1.0% other. If the card's promo multiplier is open, multiply the rate by it (Silver x2, Silver Zoom x3). Cash back = floor(amount x rate) points, at 1 point = $0.01. Add any promo statement credit whose spend threshold the purchase meets (Bronze $500 at $10,000). Note each card's first-year annual fee (0 where an open waiver applies; otherwise Bronze $0.00, Silver $122.50, Gold $200.00, Platinum $450.00, Green $100.00, Silver Zoom $74.50).
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Recommend the single business card with the highest cash back plus promo credit on the purchase. Show the breakdown: base cash back, extra from a promo multiplier or statement credit, and the total. Also state its first-year annual fee and minimum credit requirements, e.g. Platinum requires a personal credit score of $765 and PAYDEX 77. If the winner is the Silver Zoom Card, say it is built for transportation and logistics operators and that its triple cash back must be claimed in the account portal within the claim window. Confirm the totals if the customer restates them.
steps.quote: Travel, software, and media advertising purchases earn 4.0%.

steps.do: If the customer wants to apply for the recommended card, ask for any of their full name, annual income and Rho-Bank+ subscription status (yes/no) they have not already given.
steps.if: the customer says they want to apply for the recommended card
steps.quote: Submit your application with accurate contact details so we can request any supporting documentation promptly

steps.do: Tell the customer to submit the application with apply_for_credit_card. Use card_type = the exact name of the recommended card (e.g. 'Business Platinum Rewards Card', 'Silver Zoom Card'), customer_name = their full name, annual_income = their stated income, and rho_bank_subscription = their stated Rho-Bank+ status.
steps.if: the customer has confirmed they want to apply for the recommended card
steps.quote: Submit the application through your online dashboard or with assistance from a commercial lending specialist; include accurate contact information for follow-up.

steps.do: After the customer submits, remind them of the conditions that protect the return. Silver Zoom: claim the triple cash back offer in the portal before the claim window ends. Bronze: spend $10,000 net within 2 months. All cards: the bonus rate depends on how the merchant codes the charge. Returns reduce cash back.
steps.quote: Select the triple cash back offer and confirm your acceptance within the claim window

steps.do: If the application returns an error or is declined, say what the result was and which eligibility requirements apply. Do not invent an approval. If the customer cannot be helped any further and agrees, transfer with transfer_to_human_agents, giving a summary and the reason.

args.reason: application error or request outside agent capability

steps.if: the application call fails or is declined and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: Meeting the minimum criteria of $680 and 57 does not guarantee approval

rules.rule: A card's bonus rate applies only to purchases in that card's bonus categories. Everything else earns the card's base rate.
rules.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

rules.rule: Business Silver: 10.0% on eligible travel and software, 1.0% on all other purchases.
rules.quote: Earn 10.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases

rules.rule: Business Silver's merchant exclusions (including Apple, Microsoft and Dell for software) earn 1.0%, not 10.0%, and they still apply during the double cash back promo.
rules.quote: Merchant category exclusions continue to apply (see Exceptions and Exclusions)

rules.rule: Business Silver double cash back: 2x on all purchases for 6 months, only for accounts opened 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14.
rules.quote: New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening their account.

rules.rule: Business Platinum: 4.0% on travel, software and media; 1.5% on everything else.
rules.quote: Purchases outside those categories earn 1.5%.

rules.rule: Business Platinum software rate covers SaaS and enterprise software licenses billed by software providers.
rules.quote: SaaS subscriptions and enterprise software licenses billed by software providers.

rules.rule: Business Platinum credit limit is $75,000 to $400,000. Minimum personal credit score $765.
rules.quote: Maximum available credit limit: $400,000

rules.rule: Business Platinum first-year fee is 0 for new customers opening 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28. Standard fee $450.00.
rules.quote: Offer is for new customers only and applies to new accounts opened within the promotion window.

rules.rule: Business Gold: 2.5% on operations spend, 1.0% on everything else. The rate follows the merchant's category code.
rules.quote: Your rate depends on how the merchant is coded, not the product or service description alone.

rules.rule: Business Gold credit limit is $37,500 to $225,000. Annual fee $200.00.
rules.quote: Initial credit limits start at $37,500 and may reach up to $225,000, subject to credit approval and ongoing account review.

rules.rule: Business Bronze: 1.0% cash back. $500 statement credit for $10,000 spend in the first 2 months, for accounts opened 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31.
rules.quote: Spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit.

rules.rule: Business Bronze credit line is at most $50,000, so a larger single purchase cannot go on it.
rules.quote: Your initial credit line will be at least $10,000 and may be as high as $50,000 based on underwriting.

rules.rule: Business Silver credit limit is $17,500 to $112,500.
rules.quote: Approved credit limits generally range from $17,500 to $112,500, subject to credit review and business financials

rules.rule: Green Rewards: 3.0% at sustainable merchants, 1.0% elsewhere. Credit limit $14,000 to $75,000.
rules.quote: Approved credit lines are assigned within a range from $14,000 to $75,000.

rules.rule: Silver Zoom triple cash back: 3x the standard rates (3 x 3.0% transportation/logistics, 3 x 1.0% other) for 9 months. Must be claimed between 2024-01-01 and 2025-12-31.
rules.quote: All other eligible purchases earn 3 × 1.0% during the promo period

rules.rule: Silver Zoom credit limit is $22,500 to $175,000. Annual membership $74.50.
rules.quote: Approved accounts receive a credit line within a range that starts at $22,500 and can extend up to $175,000 based on underwriting

rules.rule: Silver Zoom is built for transportation and logistics operators.
rules.quote: Established transportation and logistics operators that can meet both personal and business credit criteria

rules.rule: Cash back points are floored to whole points. 1 point = $0.01.
rules.quote: these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit

draft.done_when: The agent has recommended one business card with the cash back, promo and total return on the purchase. Then either the customer has submitted apply_for_credit_card for that card and received post-application guidance, or the customer has declined to apply.
